notes: Fusing אַף כִּי into a single *How much more when* unit was the competing analysis; the split was taken because each morpheme owns a distinct part of the English under rule 30's subtraction test, כִּי carrying the *when* the ASV writes at the head of its clause.
זִמָּה → *a wicked mind* heads on *wicked*, the generic *mind* being the supplied word (rule 31).
The margin's *Or, to atone for wickedness* was read and set aside (rule 38).
